title: ID0452679-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R9 170002726] Logs Check
description:
Hello,
A customer tried to charger on the charger 170002726 on the 27th of September, but he had 2 0 recharges. He tried at 08:00:36 p.m and at 08:05:29 p.m. Can you check logs, please?
Thank you in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0452679-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R9 170002726] Logs Check CRM:03056000036
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0452679.
The ticket has been opened for a failed AC charging session on 27.09.2025 at charger
MP/R9 170002726.
I analyzed the logs, and I saw the following pattern:
The session is not a 0-session per se, as there is a transfer of current which lasts around 15 seconds.
We checked in the past the log message "AC1: SECC not longer requires closed contactor: stop charging" with R&D, and the answer provided is that such stop message is triggered by the EV, since the PilotState changes from C-->B at the same time as the above error message, instead of C2-->C1.
As such, I checked the the logs of AC charging sessions over the last 2 months, and
only this session seem to be interrupted in this way,
which means that as per R&D said it could be stopped by the EV. Since EcoG logs are not generated for AC charging sessions, and the EVMAC is not communicated as well, there are no test possible to perform in order to understand which EV could have requested a stop.
In conclusion, the AC charging interruption seem to be a one time event, most likely caused by the EV.
I hope my answer provided you clarity to your request. Please let me know if there are follow up questions on the logs. I will proceed to close the ticket if there are no further pending actions.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
